findings.detail: bvn length: handler requires exactly 10 characters, spec requires exactly 11 (minLength 11, maxLength 11)
findings.evidence: Line: `if (!req.body || String(req.body.bvn || "").length !== 10) {` — the handler returns 400 when the bvn is not exactly 10 characters, so an 11-character bvn, which the spec marks valid (minLength 11, maxLength 11), is rejected. The handler's own error message ("bvn must be 11 digits") contradicts the check it guards. (verified: {"success":false,"code":"invalid_bvn","message":"bvn must be 11 digits"})
